body:
Real, decisive investigation (not new code): cmdDungeonEnter transfers every player to a fixed, deterministic zone ID per dungeon (confirmed live in source) -- parties trivially queue together today via existing shared-zone architecture + already-real invite/party/XP-split commands. XP rewards already flow through the same universal awardXP path every zone uses. Only real, still-missing reward type is item/loot drops (already scoped separately). Difficulty scaling remains genuinely unresolved. Milestone 6 status corrected NOT STARTED -> PARTIALLY RESOLVED.

⚓ ☃
title: 534432532: Milestone 6 (rewards+party queue) real status correction -- 2 of 3 open questions already resolved by existing infra
